reason: The bound queue contains 13 complete events and 78 available selections. Four disjoint complete-event researchers and two critical reviewers all have useful work, including the three-event Guy shortlist.

scalingDecisions.reason: Thirteen complete events divide into four non-overlapping queues; two reviewers can independently challenge Guy's shortlist and the most consequential proposals.
scalingDecisions.expectedQualityBenefit: Complete market-family coverage plus current personnel, Support/Contrary, History Fit and independent review.
scalingDecisions.releaseCondition: Each worker returns its bound result or exact failure; individual failure does not veto independently completed publication.

qualityFindings.finding: All 78 available selections across 13 events were completed as zero-stake PASS decisions after moneyline, spread or puck-line, and total review.
qualityFindings.impact: No market family or event was dropped; all exact Pinnacle references were preserved.

qualityFindings.finding: Five NHL moneyline prices had positive single-source forecast points at the executable quote.
qualityFindings.impact: Toronto, Montreal, Detroit, NY Rangers and Minnesota were retained as PASS after explicit directional review because exact Pinnacle opposed the price and no independent calibrated bound or required corroboration existed.

qualityFindings.finding: The Washington-Dallas puck-line pair and every other current selection had an exact qualified reference; an apparent missing-reference result came from an unpopulated draft view.
qualityFindings.impact: The coordinator rejected the false blocker and completed the exact retained route.

qualityFindings.finding: Guy shortlist review considered Montreal, Toronto and Detroit.
qualityFindings.impact: No Guy call was cleared: Montreal's only positive high point was market-blended, while exact Pinnacle and the independent Dimers point opposed and final Winnipeg goalie/key Montreal availability remained unresolved.

completedWork.acknowledgmentClockLimitation: The delegation API exposed no per-message clock; the coordinator observed all six acknowledgments inside the bound window.
